_doc: #1499 The Cost page. `usage` is the SAME source the Cloud SuperApp Notify AI badge reads: the usage table c3 publishes (GET /ai/usage of cloudy-c3-api; c3-infra-api is its alias for one release; the ai-usage hook posts to POST /ai/usage/claude there), read through libs:ai-usage's AiUsageClient (the route is AiUsageClient.PATH, not spelled here). `bases` are tried in order; the fleet bearer is read at runtime from Cloud Account's secret provider under `bearer_key` and never stored. Claude windows come from the table's `claude` block; OpenRouter spend and balance from its `openrouter` block (fetched server side by the API from the OpenRouter key, which stays in the private store). `sample_openrouter` is shown, labelled sample, only when the table has no configured OpenRouter block. Metrics: five_hour, seven_day, week_left, week_est, day_tokens, month_tokens (Claude; #1543 day/month = the newest day/month of the table's claude_tokens, cost and total tokens, no longer the 5-hour session %); last_24h, last_7d, month, balance, est_30d (OpenRouter, est_30d = last_7d / 7 * 30); none. #1543 `token_columns` are the heads of the Daily and Monthly token tables (one row per UTC day / month, then one child row per model family from the API's runtime catalogue); the Weekly Now block is AiUsageModel.week, the badge's own lines.
